page.layout: One printed page (the scan shows a single leaf). Below the top of the leaf there is only a framed engraving with a decorative cartouche. Nothing else is printed in the text block.
page.notes: The leaf holds no printed text of its own. The mirror-image orange and black lettering (the title "JOH. HENRICI HEIDEGGERI / MEDULLA THEOLOGIAE CHRISTIANAE / COMPENDIUM THEOLOGIAE ... / TIGURI ... MDCXCVI") is show-through from the reverse side of the leaf, so it is left out. A violet library stamp ("STADT BIBLIOTHEK ZÜRICH" with the city arms) overlies the engraving and is left out. The engraving is a framed plate with scrolled ornament and a central motif; any lettering inside its cartouche at the top is too faint and mirrored to read, so it is not transcribed.
